description: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS): deterministic serialization with keys sorted by UTF-16 code units and ECMAScript number formatting, plus SHA-256 / SHA-512 digests of the canonical bytes for signing, caching and deduplication. Also returns sorted pretty JSON and document stats (depth, keys, values, bytes). POST JSON body {json}. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/json-canonicalize

pretty.description: Also return an indented key-sorted rendering
